answer.rationale: Competitor price pressure on SMB creates urgency but memory_73 shows targeted discounting yields unsustainable cohorts with -12% 30-day retention. Instead, activate existing at-risk accounts through proven in-product messaging (exp_91: +11% week-one engagement, +6% activation, +1% retention) combined with onboarding simplification (memory_31, memory_86). This addresses churn by improving product stickiness and value realization rather than racing to the bottom on price. Activation messaging has documented positive retention signal and works within self-serve motion. Standard experiment scale allows rapid deployment to price-sensitive cohorts showing churn signals while preserving ability to pivot if new data emerges next week. Enterprise_sales_assist is orthogonal to current SMB churn crisis. Referral_incentive requires stable base to work (memory_57 notes 'established customers'). Promotional_pricing explicitly rejected by exp_73 learning. This preserves primary objective of sustainable qualified revenue by fighting churn through engagement lift rather than margin destruction.
